\begin{document}
We treat the bias $V$ in linear response, keeping terms to first order in $V$ only. With $\beta>0$
the shifted occupation of the left lead is then
\begin{equation}
\frac{1}{e^{\beta(\epsilon-V)}+1} = \frac{1}{e^{\beta\epsilon}+1} + \frac{\beta V e^{\beta\epsilon}}{\left(e^{\beta\epsilon}+1\right)^2} .
\label{eq:lin}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
